Create a new terminal tab in the current: Create a new terminal tab in the current session or on optional asset_id (an owner-checked, supported, live session; assets are never auto-connected unless connect=true explicitly opts in, in which case a missing live session is established first and a creation failure after a successful connect names the residual session). Starts a new shell and requires user confirmation; optional title sets the tab title, optional command is the startup command (supported only by ssh/docker/local/device sessions; it is written verbatim to the new shell's standard input, and when it contains newlines it runs as multiple commands in sequence; unsupported kinds such as winrm are rejected, in which case create the tab first and then send the command with send_keys passing tab_id). Returns the new tab's tab_id and stable handle; by default the tab is shown in the foreground of the user's workspace, the AI works in it, and the user can take over input at any time; with background=true the tab is created detached in the background instead, and the user can take over in 「バックグラウンドセッション」 (Background Sessions). Either way, send_keys/read_screen/wait_for with tab_id can later operate tabs created by this task, including tabs on another owner-checked session.
